_comment: Each statement of RenderCasesMapper.xml with every <if> on, the first branch of each <choose>, <foreach> repeated twice and #{...} as ?. Whitespace is compared after collapsing runs to one space.
search: SELECT u.ID, u.NAME, u.CREATED_BY, u.CREATED_AT FROM USERS u WHERE u.NAME LIKE '%' || ? || '%' AND u.STATUS = ? AND u.TYPE = 'A' AND u.ID IN (?, ?)
update: UPDATE USERS SET NAME = ?, MAIL = ? WHERE ID = ? AND AGE < 100
insertAll: INSERT INTO USERS (ID, NAME) SELECT ?, ? FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT ?, ? FROM DUAL
deleteTrimmed: DELETE FROM USERS WHERE ID = ? OR NAME LIKE ?
